issues.description: Candidate 20 'MHC class II genes' and candidate 74 'c1q genes' are non-unique gene sets; they cannot be normalized to a single gene symbol.
Candidate 78 'Ly-6C' is ambiguous between Ly6c1 and Ly6c2; left unresolved.
Flow cytometry/protein markers CD11b, F4/80, CD206, and Mac2 were normalized to their coding genes Itgam, Adgre1, Mrc1, and Lgals3 respectively.
